status: Release Candidate / Experimental / Not Production Ready

invariants.statement: Each layer proves only the claim it owns.
Integrity does not imply authenticity.
Authenticity does not imply authorization.
Authenticity does not imply freshness.
Verified once does not imply authorized to execute later.
Check-then-act does not imply atomic authorization.
Executed once does not imply exactly-one external effect.
Claimed time does not imply trusted time.
Signed checkpoint does not imply globally consistent history.
Delegate key does not imply ambient authority.
Key diversity does not imply principal diversity.
Past PASS does not imply current PASS.
Selective disclosure does not imply unlinkability.
Attested runtime does not imply correct behavior.
Reproducible build does not imply benign build.
Authentic evidence is not evidence for any arbitrary claim.
Circular support does not create independent evidence.
Revoked support does not imply refuted claim.
Conflict is distinct from unsupported and refuted.
Copy count does not imply independent source count.
Confidence does not imply truth state.
Probability does not imply action or permission.
Signed human approval does not imply informed understanding.
Local safety does not imply global plan safety.
Compensation does not imply rollback of history.
Backup authenticity does not imply restore freshness or completeness.
All individually valid layers do not imply end-to-end validity.
Context compatibility is non-transitive by default.
Every compatible hop does not imply whole-chain compatibility.
Intermediate context does not become a new trust root without fresh revalidation.
Root promotion authority must be well-founded.
Emergency recovery authority is distinct from normal execution authority.
Total independent trust-anchor loss requires EXTERNAL_TRUST_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRED.
Authorized action does not authorize arbitrary implementation side effects.
Complete mediation claims are bounded by the declared mediation/TCB surface.
Approved broker measurement does not imply correct broker behavior.
Finite-domain conformance does not imply universal correctness.
Resource labels do not imply stable resource identity.
Arrival time does not imply event order.
Same display label across tenants/environments does not imply same assurance context.

terminal_states.meaning: All independent trust anchors are unavailable; internal automatic trust recovery is not safe.
